purpose: Preserve the trader-confirmed distinction between 5-minute A+ candle-pattern identity and 1-minute causal intrabar reconstruction so future implementations cannot drift into a separate 1-minute candlestick strategy.
trader_observation: Price rejected the key level and the trader took the reversal. The same A+ move looks different on 5m versus 1m: the trader recognizes the candle/momentum story on the 5-minute execution chart, while the 1-minute chart shows the smaller internal path of that forming 5-minute candle.

frozen_rules.primary_entry_pattern_rule: A+ candle-pattern identity, rejection/reversal story and momentum-candle geometry are judged on the 5-minute execution candle/sequence unless an already-frozen 15-minute continuation family explicitly applies.
frozen_rules.one_minute_role: Completed 1-minute sub-bars are causal intrabar observations used to reconstruct the forming 5-minute parent candle and determine whether directional force is sustained before the parent close.
frozen_rules.micro_pullbacks_allowed_inside_valid_5m_: A valid forming 5-minute momentum candle may contain smaller 1-minute pullbacks, pauses or opposite-color sub-bars. Those micro bars do not invalidate the 5-minute momentum story by themselves. The path must still satisfy the frozen sustained-force/tug-of-war controls and regain directional control before entry.
frozen_rules.aggregate_not_vote: Do not require every completed 1-minute sub-bar to independently satisfy momentum geometry or have the same candle color. Evaluate the causally aggregated forming parent geometry plus path efficiency, giveback and latest-close directional-extreme rules.
frozen_rules.reversal_example: Key-level rejection -> 5-minute bullish reversal/momentum response can be A+ even though the 1-minute decomposition is a sequence of smaller bullish bars with micro pullbacks rather than one visually identical large momentum candle. Shorts mirror this rule.

engineering_effect: This is a direct fidelity clarification, not parameter tuning. Existing force thresholds are unchanged; the guard constrains timeframe interpretation and future refactors.
